parsed.summary: After tracing power rails, the FCC/NAVC inter‑MCU link, the I2C/SPI/UART buses, the crystal/feedback networks and every passive value, the drawing is internally consistent and electrically sound; the few apparent conflicts with the specification text (PCA9685 strap/note = 0x41 vs spec '0x40', GPS VCC = 3.3 V vs spec's '5 V feeds the GPS module', TMP100 note 0x4E) are errors in the spec document, not deviations in the board — the schematic values are in fact required for correct operation (a PCA9685 at 0x40 would collide with the INA219 at 0x40 on the same I2C2 bus, and the u‑blox MAX‑8Q VCC is 2.7–3.6 V, not 5 V), and the MPRLS RESET/INT swap is the documented 'RESET AND INTERRUPT PINS ARE MIXED UP!!!!!' known bug. No drawing‑supported anomaly was found.
